subject: company map
decision: The project map is derived from the repository, never authored by agents
rationale: A prose knowledge base rots: docs/learning/ was written in by 1 agent of 13 and went stale immediately. Everything in project_map is computed from artifacts that already exist, so it cannot drift and costs no agent effort. record_decision is the single exception and is append-only.

subject: Capacity review 2026-08-03
decision: No immediate hires or fires. The company is at full headcount (13/13) with no open work in todo or in-progress states except a few cards assigned mainly to senior dev and UI dev. These roles are currently the bottleneck in terms of workload. No other roles show immediate capacity issues.
rationale: The tech lead reports high workload concentration on senior dev and UI dev roles, with no open work backlog. QA and other roles appear balanced. No idle agents identified. Recommend monitoring workload and redistributing tasks if needed.

subject: Prioritize fixing ghost_ai and ghost_visuals module bugs
decision: Company priority to focus on fixing missing ghost_ai and ghost_visuals modules and related import errors to unblock backend and senior dev work.
rationale: These bugs are critical blockers with many overdue cards and are preventing progress on key features and tests.
